title: Degree-Guided Adiabatic Quantum Algorithm for MIS with Neutral Atoms
summary: We present a quantum adiabatic algorithm for solving MIS with Rydberg atoms, which uses graph degrees to engineer the Hamiltonian for adiabatic evolution. Our approach extends the algorithm of Pichler et al. for MIS state preparation, which uses time-dependent global controls to excite atoms while the Rydberg blockade mechanism suppresses adjacent excitations.
